people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Yahweh called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”
translations.bsb: Then the LORD called to Samuel, and he answered, “Here I am.”
translations.kjv: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here am I.
translations.asv: that Jehovah called Samuel; and he said, Here am I.
